source_title: 'Prahaar' day 14: The film falls Rs 31.39 cr short of reported Rs 60 cr budget
source_excerpt: Rajkummar Rao and Wamiqa Gabbi's courtroom drama 'Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story' has completed its second week in theaters. The film has recorded a worldwide gross collection of Rs 28.61 cr so far. However, its box office performance remains below the level required to match its reported production budget. According to Sacnilk, the movie earned Rs 28 lakh net in India on Thursday, October 29. The collection came from 1,156 shows across the country.The latest figures take its domestic net earnings to Rs 21.57 cr. Its India gross collection stands at Rs 25.66 cr. Overseas markets have contributed a cumulative gross of Rs 2.95 cr. This takes the film's worldwide theatrical gross to Rs 28.61 cr.'Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story' box office collection: Week two performanceThe film's second week began with Rs 60 lakh on Friday, October 23. Its earnings improved over the weekend, with Saturday bringing in Rs 1.15 cr. Sunday registered Rs 1.20 cr, marking the strongest collection of the second week.The movie subsequently witnessed a decline during the weekdays. Monday and Tuesday each contributed Rs 45 lakh. Wednesday's earnings stood at Rs 29 lakh, while Thursday added Rs 28 lakh. The second week ended with Rs 4.42 cr in domestic net collections across 7,486 shows.'Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story' daily box office collectionThe Rajkummar Rao-starrer opened with Rs 2.35 cr on October 16. Collections increased to Rs 3.15 cr on Saturday, followed by Rs 3.65 cr on Sunday. The film's opening weekend provided its strongest start during the theatrical run.Its first Monday brought in Rs 2 cr, before Tuesday witnessed an improvement with Rs 3.30 cr. The earnings then dropped to Rs 1.50 cr on Wednesday and Rs 1.20 cr on Thursday. Night screenings recorded the highest occupancy among the four show timings.'Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story': Budget, cast and storyAccording to Bollywood Movie Reviewz, the film was made on an estimated production budget of Rs 60 cr. Its current worldwide gross is Rs 28.61 cr, leaving a difference of Rs 31.39 cr. This comparison is based on the reported production budget and theatrical gross. The film's overall financial performance will also depend on revenue from other sources.The movie features Rajkummar Rao, Wamiqa Gabbi, Lalit Prabhakar, Jaideep Ahlawat and Sikandar Kher. It explores public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam's role in major legal battles involving the 1993 Bombay bombings and the 2008 Mumbai attacks.
